items.title: Novo Nordisk (CPSE:NOVO B) Sues Eli Lilly Over GLP 1 Drug Advertising
items.summary: Novo Nordisk (CPSE:NOVO B) has filed a federal lawsuit against Eli Lilly over alleged false and misleading advertising of GLP-1 obesity and diabetes drugs. The company argues that Eli Lilly’s ads misrepresent clinical comparisons and risk misleading consumers and healthcare professionals. The case highlights rising tensions as both companies compete in the fast growing market for GLP-1 based obesity and diabetes treatments.
